hero.html:
Level 4 - Advanced 45 min Concurrency Drills

Thread-Safe LRU Cache, Rate Limiter & Counters

Three classes interviewers love to say "now make it thread-safe" about. Learn a repeatable recipe, why get() on an LRU is secretly a write (so "just add a read lock" corrupts it), a per-key token bucket that never lets 11 requests through a limit of 10, and when AtomicLong, LongAdder or a lock is the right counter. Every claim on this page was run.
